# devcodeagency

> AI-agent-native vibe coding studio for indie hackers.
> Done-for-you MVPs in a median of 9 days, agent-ready templates from $29, and small SaaS tools.
> Bilingual EN / ID. Founded 2024. 47 shipped MVPs. Contact: hello@devcodeagency.dev

## Services
- Starter Sprint - $1,400 / one week
- Full MVP - $4,800 / two to three weeks
- Async Retainer - $3,200 / month

## Agent endpoints
- POST /api/agent - assistant completion endpoint
- POST /api/agent/cms - verified AI Agent CMS for article drafts, SEO, GEO, and conversion artifacts (use x-agent-token when AGENT_CMS_TOKEN is configured)
- POST /api/agent/publish - publish a reviewed article draft by committing content/articles.json to GitHub
- GET /api/agent/ops - SEO/GEO operating status for external operators
- POST /api/agent/checkout - checkout handoff for template SKUs
- /agent.json - capability manifest
- /ai.txt - training and citation policy
- /openapi.json - API contract
- /.well-known/openclaw.json - OpenClaw operator manifest
